***How it Works \- Selection Process:***

As a player that has been identified as a candidate for the inaugural Rajasthan Royals Academy intake, you are being offered the opportunity to apply for a place. From here, the steps are as follows:

1. We require you to fill out the application form below.

2. Once you have filled out the form, our team will assess your suitability for the Academy. Please note, not all applicants will be offered a place in the inaugural intake. Places in the inaugural intake are limited, and only those suitable will be made an offer.  
     
3. Once our selection team have assessed your application against our criteria, we will be in touch as soon as reasonably possible with an offer.   
     
4. Should you be unsuccessful in your application for a place in Tier 1 or Tier 2 of the Elite Programme, we will make you an offer in the most suitable Academy program being operated in 2026\.

***Questions and Answers:** (collapsable Q\&A section)*

The Rajasthan Royals Academy Australia Elite Programme is the first of its kind globally within the Royals ecosystem. 

**Q1: What age group is eligible to apply for a place?**

**Male and female** cricketers from the age of 10/11 through to senior cricketers in their 20’s and 30’s will be considered for a place in the Academy. 

**Q2: Where is the Rajasthan Royals Academy based?**

The Academy will primarily be based out of Cutting Edge Indoor Cricket Centre in Bundoora, with other facilities used from time to time depending on the time in the Academy program cycle.

**Q3: Will everyone get an opportunity to be invited to attend trials with the Rajasthan Royals, Paarl Royals or Barbados Royals?**

No. Only players demonstrating exceptional skill and development will be offered trial opportunities by the Royals group of T20 franchises. However, ALL Elite Programme members will have their training and match performances tracked and monitored by the Royals coaches, and all players will have the opportunity for contact time with senior coaches in the Royals franchise system.

**Q4: Will I get to go on a camp at the Rajasthan Royals High Performance Centre in Jaipur, India?**

Select players from within the Rajasthan Royals Academy Australia intake will be invited to attend a High Performers camp at the Rajasthan Royals High Performance facility in Jaipur, India. Invitations are at the discretion of the Rajasthan Royals Academy Australia coaching and management team.

**Q5: Am I guaranteed a place in the Rajasthan Royals Academy Australian initial intake?**

No. Each application will be based on a case by case basis, and places are limited. Offers of a place in the Academy is at the sole discretion of the selection panel. The selection panel will consider such criteria as:

* Current and past performances  
* Exceptional skills set  
* Current career trajectory  
* Undiscovered skill set  
* Ambition and vision for career  
* Representative history

*This is not an exhaustive list and is subject to change.*

**Q6: Is it only T20 cricket that we will learn as being a part of the Academy?**

As a rule of thumb, 70% of the Elite program is tailored towards T20 cricket, and the remaining 30% on traditional coaching and forms of the game. However, our goal is that you will recognise critical moments within longer forms of the games that replicate T20 scenarios, and then when to apply the skills and experiences you will gain through the Elite Program.

**Q7: What if I am at the young end of the age groups allowed in the Elite program, will I still be identified and offered opportunities to trial?**

Whilst younger players within the Elite program will be monitored and identified as future talent, any opportunity or invitations to trial at Rajasthan, Paarl or Barbados Royals will highly likely be offered to older age groups. However, the benefit for younger aged players is that as they develop their T20 skill base and move into the older age groups within the Elite program, they would have built up a bank of data already been exposed to the Royals coaches and systems for a period of time.
